brief_reason: Evidence supports the Soviet Latvia alias but never mentions 2016, so the temporal qualifier is unwarranted.
Evidence makes Pocahontas the daughter of Powhatan, paramount chief of Tsenacommacah, but does not identify that chief or polity as Wahunsenacah.
Evidence says Sacré-Cœur is publicly dedicated to the Sacred Heart devotion, which neither equates to nor rules out the claim's reading of dedication to a cult.
Evidence locates the building at 200 N.W. 5th Street but does not say it was demolished there.
Evidence says the Qin dynasty introduced several reforms of currency, measures, and writing, not that those reforms were legislation.
Evidence discusses speech-recognition history and vendors but is silent on online gaming and popularity therein.
Evidence places Brazzers in Montreal, Canada, and does not mention Quebec.
Evidence says Jones missed the playoffs once and distinguishes playoffs from the NBA Finals, so a one-time Finals miss is neither established nor contradicted.
